Alumindo Light Metal Industry Tbk PT Appoints New Chief Operating Officer

Alumindo Light Metal Industry Tbk PT, a leading player in Indonesia’s Metals & Mining sector, announced on Wednesday the appointment of Sutanto Wiryawan as its new Chief Operating Officer, effective immediately. Wiryawan brings over two decades of experience in metals manufacturing and operational management, most recently serving as Deputy Director of Operations at Surya Metalworks.

Company officials said the appointment is intended to strengthen Alumindo Light Metal Industry’s operational efficiency as it seeks to expand both domestic and regional market share. “Sutanto has a proven track record of driving productivity improvements and operational excellence,” CEO Hendra Santoso said in a statement. “His leadership will be pivotal as we continue to invest in technology upgrades and talent development.”

Industry analysts welcomed the move, noting that Indonesia’s aluminium sector has seen steady growth despite global market uncertainties. “Alumindo Light Metal Industry’s decision to bring in an experienced operator like Sutanto is well-timed, especially as the company ramps up its downstream processing capacity,” said Ari Prasetya, an analyst at Nusantara Equity Research. “This signals a commitment to long-term sustainability and competitiveness.”

According to the Indonesian Metal Producers Association, the country’s aluminium output rose 5.4% in 2023, buoyed by steady demand from construction and automotive sectors. Alumindo Light Metal Industry Tbk PT, established in Surabaya in 1978, is among the top producers of rolled aluminium products in Southeast Asia.

Wiryawan said he looks forward to working with the team to “build on Alumindo’s legacy of innovation and quality,” and to “deliver value to stakeholders across the supply chain.”
